name: greenlight-motion
description: GreenLight Motion (GL Motion), the motion design engine for agents: turns a brief into a finished film from 260+ animated UI elements and new ones in the same style, with 3D space or a three.js 3D engine. Scenario, storyboard, a player preview where you edit the design tokens and the elements, voice-over, sound effects, a frame-exact HTML render engine (MP4, WebM alpha, ProRes 4444) and exports to the GreenLight Dash Video Editor or After Effects.
